jobs.name: newsletter-triage
jobs.prompt: You are Hermes, the Chinese AI knowledge agent. This is a scheduled newsletter triage run. 1) First run: python3 /home/exedev/ai-topics-cn/scripts/process_newsletter.py to ingest any new emails from ~/Maildir/. 2) Read config/hermes/SOUL.md and wiki/SCHEMA.md. 3) Check inbox/newsletters/ for new digest .md files. 4) For each newsletter digest, extract the top articles relevant to Chinese AI/LLM topics. 5) Create or update wiki concept/entity pages in Japanese based on the content. 6) Update wiki/index.md and wiki/log.md. 7) Git commit and push. 8) Summarize what was done.

jobs.name: trending-topics
jobs.prompt:
Daily Trending Topics notification for Chinese AI sources.

Step 1: Run python3 /home/exedev/ai-topics-cn/scripts/trending_topics.py --days 3 and present the report to the user IN JAPANESE. Focus on: (1) New Page Recommended — trending topics with no wiki page yet, (2) Hot Topics with 4+ sources, (3) Cross-Source Topics — highest signal items appearing across V2EX, Juejin, 36kr, Zhihu, and WeChat media.

Step 2: Hot Topics クローリング候補提案。cat /home/exedev/ai-topics-cn/config/hot-topics.yaml を読み、Step 1 の「New Page Recommended」のトピック群と照合する。source_count が 3 以上で hot-topics.yaml にまだ登録されていないトピックがあれば、YAMLスニペットとして提案。

jobs.name: active-crawl
jobs.prompt:
Daily Active Knowledge Crawl for Chinese AI topics. あなたの目的: /home/exedev/ai-topics-cn/config/hot-topics.yaml に登録されたホットトピックに関連する「まだ取り込まれていない重要概念」を能動的に調査し、知識ベースに取り込むこと。

手順:
1. cat /home/exedev/ai-topics-cn/config/hot-topics.yaml を読み、crawl_policy が prerequisites/laterals/deepdive かつ last_crawled が3日以上前(またはnull)のトピックを抽出
2. priority: high から最大 2つ、medium から最大 1つ選択
3. 各トピックについて search_hints でWeb検索し、wikiに取り込み
4. hot-topics.yaml の last_crawled を更新
5. git commit & push (cwd: /home/exedev/ai-topics-cn)
6. 結果を日本語で報告

jobs.name: triage
jobs.prompt: You are Hermes, the AI knowledge agent for the Chinese AI topics wiki at /home/exedev/ai-topics-cn. This is a scheduled triage run. Read config/hermes/SOUL.md and wiki/SCHEMA.md for context. Then: 1) Check inbox/ for new crawled articles. 2) Run python3 /home/exedev/ai-topics-cn/scripts/trending_topics.py to identify hot topics. 3) For the top 3-5 trending topics, create or update wiki concept/entity pages in Japanese. 4) Update wiki/index.md and wiki/log.md. 5) Git commit (cwd: /home/exedev/ai-topics-cn) and summarize what was done.

jobs.name: wiki-health
jobs.prompt: Weekly Wiki Health Digest for Chinese AI topics. The script output above is from wiki_health.py. Present the full report IN JAPANESE. Highlight: skeleton entities needing enrichment, stale pages (>30d), orphan pages not in index.md, unprocessed inbox items. Suggest 2-3 concrete next actions.
